title: Mixed Conditionals
rule: Mixed conditionals combine different time references.
pattern: If + past perfect, would + base verb (or reverse)

examples.text: If I had studied law, I would be a lawyer now.
If she were more confident, she would have spoken up.
If they hadn't moved, we would still be neighbors.
If he were here, he would have fixed it.
If I had taken that job, I would live abroad.

practicePrompt: Complete: If I ___ (learn) Spanish, I would travel more in Latin America.
